detail.longDescription: I’ve just made public a collection of more than 50 science fiction and philosophy books written with AI assistance. The books are part of an European research project exploring how AI-assisted books can be created, evaluated, and analyzed. They are meant to be genuinely readable, and many of them develop unusual perspectives and ideas in good depth. I’d be very interested in feedback from the HN community—on the writing, the ideas, the research direction, or the project itself.
